name: telemetry_sdk
_comment: Delivery-policy owner for the Next.js telemetry lane (ADR-005/ADR-006), mirroring telemetry/dart. base_sdk owns the TelemetryClient every SDK may import (base/nextjs/src/services/telemetry.ts, installed at app/services/base/telemetry.ts); this SDK formally owns WHEN/HOW events leave the browser (the seam/config), so composing it declares the telemetry lane without copying any files. No pages, no routes, no HTTP of its own: all merge blocks are empty by design, like the dart half's. The frappe half (core/telemetry) is the backend: api_error_log + log_frontend_error/track_event whitelisted methods.
